children: Amazon.com Inc (AMZN, Financials), the e-commerce and cloud behemoth, has barred Meta's Muse AI agent from buying on its retail platform, making a spat over access a broader test for AI-powered commerce.

Muse was built to fulfilll users' needs, including locating products and completing online shopping. Amazon began blocking the agent Sunday after Meta refused a request to exclude Amazon from the experience.
Amazon said shopping agents have to identify themselves and get authorization from the retailer. The company also says automated agents can raise issues about client data and security.

There's another problem with that argument. Amazon's retail site is a big revenue generator for advertising, and AI agents could revolutionize the way shoppers find things by going around Amazon's storefront and recommendation system.
The block is not specific to Meta. The debate is part of a bigger battle over agentic commerce, with Amazon also banning AI purchasing solutions from the likes of OpenAI, Google and Perplexity.

The setback for Meta comes as it seeks to pitch Muse as a method to automate mundane actions like shopping. For Amazon, the question is whether it can retain control of the buying experience as AI agents get more powerful.
The next challenge will be whether AI firms and big platforms can agree on access standards that do not constrain how consumers utilize these new agents.

title: Amazon Just Blocked Meta's AI Agent and It's Not Alone
